2. Counsel for the petitioner submits that 
even though petitioner has remedy of 
approaching the Cooperative Tribunal; 
however, the Cooperative Tribunal has 
become non-functional because of expiry of 
term of Chairperson and one member. Thus,
it is contended that in the absence of 
quorum, Tribunal is not in a position to 
decide the matter.
3. State Counsel shall get instructions on 
the said aspect.

regarding the time needed for filling the

 Versus

Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Aditya Purohit, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. P.S. Bisht, learned Chief Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
3. Mr. Siddhant Manral, learned counsel
for the respondent –Bank.
4. In sequel to the order dated 
29.06.2026, Mr. Dheeraj Singh Garbyal, 
Secretary, Tourism is virtually present. He 
submits that since Secretary, Cooperative is 
on leave, therefore, he is acting as Link 
Officer on his behalf. He submits that two 
members of Cooperative Tribunal have 
recently been appointed on 25.06.2026 and 
on 29.06.2026, respectively. He submits that 
Cooperative Tribunal is now functional, as 
there is no prohibition in the Statute that the 
Tribunal cannot function in the absence of 
Chairperson. He further submits that process 
for appointing Chairperson is on and 
advertisement inviting application would be 
published shortly.
5. In such view of the matter, personal  presence of Link Officer/Secretary, 
Cooperative is dispensed with for future 
dates of hearing.
6. Petitioner contends that he is simply a 
guarantor, however, instead of recovering 
the amount of loan from the terminal dues 
of the borrower, the entire amount is sought 
to be recovered from him in purported 
compliance of the award given by the 
Arbitrator. It is contended that the manner 
in which petitioner is being liable to pay the 
entire amount is unjust and illegal.
7. Let counter affidavit(s) be filed within 
three weeks.
8. List this case on 29.07.2026.
9. Till the next date of listing, no coercive 
action shall be taken against the petitioner 
on the strength of impugned recovery 
citation. 
10. Interim relief application (IA No. 1 of 
2026) stands disposed of. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 30.06.2026
Aswal
